snippet.title: Jumanji: The Video Game - PS5 Feature Trailer
snippet.description:
Return to the jungle on PS5! Experience the beautiful and dangerous world of Jumanji: The Video Game with all-new enhanced features exclusive to the PlayStation 5: 

- Up to 120 FPS 
- 4K Dynamic Resolution 
- HDR 
- Faster Loading Times 
- Free upgrade for existing PS4 owners

Learn more 👉 https://outrightgames.com/games/jumanji-the-video-game/
